summaries.Good news: Nature is staging a quiet comeback—a 17th-century garden emerged from the earth after 350 years, endangered puffins are breeding again on English cliffs, and the critically endangered vaquita porpoise is being preserved through digital innovation before it's too late.
summaries.Ideas: Design thinking is reshaping how we approach naming and clarity (airlines), bulk workflows (Google Photos), and the future of labor itself—while raising urgent questions about surveillance and who truly benefits from AI advancement.
summaries.Technology: From autonomous vehicles that drive themselves home to folding phones reaching maturity, this week showcases how hardware innovation is solving real problems: last-mile transport, cargo hauling, and sleep quality.
summaries.Design: Thoughtful spatial design is elevating everyday infrastructure—from a sculptural public toilet with timber canopy to breakthrough furniture that requires no fasteners, proving that utility and beauty aren't opposing forces.
